CardDescription.DefaultText: A low wooden drag with curved runners. Carries heavy loads across snow and can be used for fast downhill transportation and entertainment.
CardDescription.Text: 一种带有弯曲滑轨的低矮木制拖曳装置。用于在雪地上拖运重物，可以快速下坡运输和娱乐。
CardDescription.zh: 一种带有弯曲滑轨的低矮木制拖曳装置。用于在雪地上拖运重物，可以快速下坡运输和娱乐。
CardDescription.en: A low wooden drag with curved runners. Carries heavy loads across snow and can be used for fast downhill transportation and entertainment.
CardDescription.ja: 湾曲した滑走板を備えた低い木製そり。雪上で重荷を運べるほか、坂を滑り降りることもできる。
